# Agatha Sowerby

## Appearance

She is a stout woman who weighs two hundred pounds and whose gait is a perpetual waddle. She has a heavy body, making walking carrying her weight tiring on her feet.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v1 c38 P30](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0030), [v1 c38 P31](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0031)_

## Personality

She is a candid, sharp-tongued, and intrusive busybody who takes pride in voicing her opinions without fear or partiality. Despite her critical nature and lack of delicate tact, she possesses a kind, compassionate heart and shows great generosity toward those in need. She enjoys being consulted for counsel and holds durable, passionate opinions on religion, politics, and social propriety. She disbelieves in higher education for women and harbors a distinct prejudice against outsiders and Americans.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c27 P3](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0003), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v1 c36 P32](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0032), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048), [v2 c1 P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 c4 P27](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0027), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v2 c25 P32](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0032)_

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby managed her household at Sowerby's Hollow in Brierley while heavily involving herself in local church and civic organizations. When Nell Harcourt first arrived in Brierley, Mrs. Agatha visited Grey Shutters and made blunt remarks about her hair and freckles, sparking a fiery outburst from Nell; however, Nell later apologized, and Mrs. Agatha readily forgave her. She took charge of selecting gloria fabric and tailoring a surprise dress for Nell at Obed Abernethy's request. Over the next three years, she closely observed Nell's development, frequently offering unwanted advice on upbringing and opposing higher education for women. When her husband Thomas fell ill, she cared for him tenderly until his peaceful death. Facing financial difficulty and a mortgage on their farm after his passing, she accepted Thirza Abernethy's invitation to move into Grey Shutters as a lifelong friend and companion.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c38 P31](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0031), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026)_
